args.reason: The --dry-run part serves the inspection goal, but the DoD also adds a persisted .faff/merge-gate-history/<pr>.jsonl log, an --explain timeline renderer, a --since filter and a --format toggle. The PRD explicitly says historical storage and query features are outside its scope, so this is capability beyond the declared goals (gold-plating). Phase 1 called it a natural extension of inspection, but the PRD excludes it by name.
